name: Physics I Mechanics: Kinetrix
subtitle: Adaptive Physics I course
shortDescription: Adaptive Physics I mechanics course with quizzes, interactive labs and worked solutions. Free to use.
longDescription:
Physics I Mechanics: Kinetrix is a first-year university mechanics course that adapts to the mistakes you actually make. It covers units and uncertainty, vectors, kinematics, Newton's laws, friction and circular motion, drag, work and energy, momentum and collisions, centre of mass, rotation and torque, angular momentum, static equilibrium, gravitation and orbits, and oscillations.

### Learn Your Way
- Syllabus view: topics in classical course order. Real-World view: start from a real problem (stop a car, aim a launcher, design a ramp) and learn what each step needs. 9 problem tracks and 14 build tasks, each linked to a lab and practice questions. Switch any time; your progress is shared.
- A short starting check, then a personalised path: each question is picked from your weak topics, the specific mistake patterns it has seen (a forgotten square, a mixed-up sign) and topics due for spaced review. Or follow the fixed syllabus path.
- Every question has a full worked solution with numbered steps and a note on the common mistake. Every wrong answer links straight back to the idea behind it.

3D LABS
Eight interactive 3D labs you can orbit and drag: projectile motion with air drag, a free-body incline with friction, collisions from sticky to elastic, an orbit sandbox, spring and pendulum oscillators, a rolling race, a torque seesaw and an Atwood machine. Predict first, run it, then check your prediction against the computed value.

### What Is Covered
161 course points, each with a short lesson and at least 8 practice questions (over 1,300 questions in all, written for this app). The points map every learning objective in OpenStax University Physics Volume 1 (chapters 1 to 13 and 15), every learning objective in the AP Physics C: Mechanics course and exam description, and every week of the MIT OpenCourseWare 8.01SC syllabus. A Coverage screen shows exact counts and links to each source. Three 25-question practice papers and a 42-question full-length paper run against the clock with no feedback until the end. Free-response written papers are not included yet.

### Private, Offline and Readable
No account and no sign-in. Your progress stays on your device and the course works offline. Text size goes from 50% to 300% with the A- and A+ buttons on every screen. Built for phones and for iPad, with a navigation rail, main pane and companion panel on large screens.
